email.subject1: a signal play for Local Express
email.body1:
Jonathan, saw Local Express closed its Series A and partnered with LOC Software for unified commerce.

Growing that fast usually means more in-market grocers than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Local Express off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jonathan, quick follow-up for Local Express.

Post-raise, pipeline expectations usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Local Express needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jonathan, last bit of proof for Local Express.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Local Express's reply rate likely compares to other grocery-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jonathan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know standing up new partnerships is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a grocery-tech motion? I will tailor it to Local Express either way.
